name: Volumetric Density Generation
aliases: Procedural Density Generation via Noise and Thresholding
definition: Generates a patchy volumetric density field from noise by applying a power function and a threshold.
summary: Volumetric Density Generation creates sparse, patchy density fields by applying a power function and threshold to Fractal Brownian Motion noise, distinguishing itself through explicit non-linear remapping and hard cutoffs.
